21407.context: Can't you see that his kindness is intended to turn you from sin? God's patience with you is the evidence that he is waiting for you to tell him where you are. God doesn't tell us to confess because he doesn't know the truth, we're trying to keep to ourselves. We confess so that we can be forgiven. The Bible says, if we confess our sins, he is faithful and just to forgive us of our sins and cleanse us from all unrighteousness.
21407.title: How Adam and Eve jacked up everything. (Genesis 1-3)
